dashboard.active_accounts_description: All accounts detected in the journal

settings.modules_help: Enable optional Ledgera modules. Modules are built into the app and can be turned on or off for your workflow.
settings.module_update_checker_help: Automatically check for new Ledgera releases on startup.
settings.module_git_sync_help: Commit, pull, and push journal changes from Ledgera using the system Git installation.
settings.fetch_prices_help: Retrieve current prices from Yahoo Finance for investment commodities.
settings.commodity_symbols_help: Map journal commodities to Yahoo Finance ticker symbols for price lookup.
settings.exclude_balances_help: Hide these accounts from the Balances view. One account per line.
settings.include_investments_help: Only show these accounts in the Investments view. Leave empty to hide the Investments view. One account per line.
settings.journal_path_required: Enter the path to an existing journal file
settings.prefill_postings_help: When creating a transaction, automatically fill the posting accounts based on the selected transaction type (expense, income, etc.).
settings.advanced_mode_help: Show raw journal entries, source lines, and diagnostic details.
settings.update_check_disabled: Update checks are disabled. Enable the update checker module to check for new releases.
settings.configure_journal_description: Ledgera needs a readable hledger journal and the hledger CLI before it can show your dashboard.
settings.no_journal_configured: No journal file is configured yet.
settings.journal_read_failed: The configured journal could not be loaded.
settings.hledger_not_found: The hledger CLI is not available.

transactions.movement_hint: Use this for expenses, income, and transfers. Choose where money comes from, where it goes, and enter a positive amount.
transactions.investment_hint: Use this for commodity purchases or exchanges with hledger unit price syntax.
transactions.advanced_edit_notice: Existing transactions open in Advanced mode to preserve their hledger posting structure.
transactions.delete_transaction_description: This removes the transaction block from the journal.
transactions.invalid_date: Use a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format
transactions.code_invalid: Use hledger code syntax, for example (INV-001)
transactions.single_line_field: This field cannot contain line breaks
transactions.unit_price_invalid: Unit price must contain a number
transactions.comment_placeholder: Optional note for this posting line
transactions.postings_minimum: Add at least two posting accounts
transactions.postings_amount_required: Enter an amount on at least one posting

sync.title: Git Sync
sync.description: Synchronize the configured journal files with the Git repository that contains them.
sync.status_unknown_help: Refresh Git status to inspect the configured journal repository.
sync.commit_modal_description: Review or customize the commit message before pushing your journal changes.

error_help.git_not_available: Install Git or make sure it is available in the system PATH.
error_help.git_repo_not_found: Move it into a Git repository, or turn off Git Sync.
error_help.git_sync_dirty: Commit, push, or discard local changes before pulling remote changes.
error_help.git_sync_behind: Pull remote changes before committing and pushing new changes.
error_help.git_no_journal_files: Check that the configured journal is readable and included in the repository.

errors.journal_not_configured: No journal file has been configured. Go to Settings and select your journal file.
errors.journal_not_found: The configured journal file was not found. Check that the path is correct.
errors.journal_read_failed: Unable to read the journal file. Check file permissions.
errors.journal_write_failed: Unable to write to the journal file. Check file permissions.
errors.journal_include_missing: The journal references an included file that does not exist.
errors.hledger_check_failed: hledger validation failed. The journal may contain syntax errors.
errors.hledger_not_available: hledger is not available. Install hledger or configure its path in Settings.
errors.hledger_balance_parse_failed: Unable to parse hledger balance output.
errors.transaction_not_found: The transaction could not be found. It may have been deleted or moved.
errors.transaction_validation_failed: Transaction validation failed. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.log_write_failed: Unable to write to log file.
errors.prices_disabled: Market price fetching is disabled in Settings.
errors.git_not_available: Git is not available. Install Git or make it available in PATH.
errors.git_repo_not_found: Journal not in a Git repository.
errors.git_sync_dirty: Commit or discard journal changes before pulling.
errors.git_sync_behind: Pull remote changes before committing and pushing.
errors.git_no_journal_files: No journal files are available for Git sync.
errors.git_commit_message_single_line: Commit message must be a single line.
errors.git_commit_message_too_long: Commit message must be 200 characters or fewer.
